title: Skin Care for Nagpur Weather: A Routine for Extreme Summers, Monsoon and Dry Winters
ex: Very hot, dry summers, a humid monsoon and cool, dry winters in the middle of India: a simple skin care routine for people living in Nagpur.
rt: Skin Care for Nagpur Weather: Seasonal Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Nagpur weather: sun and heat care for extreme dry summers, coolers and AC, light monsoon layers and moisture for cold, dry winter nights.
quick: Nagpur has a very hot, dry summer, a humid monsoon and a cool, dry winter with cold nights. A gentle face wash, a moisturiser, broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning and a night cream used thinly in the monsoon and more from November to February suit most skin.
facts: Nagpur is in Vidarbha, in the middle of India, far from the sea
April and May are very hot and dry
The monsoon runs roughly mid-June to September
December and January bring cold nights and dry air
